caption:
Soup poured while it's steaming

The soup was steaming and the mug was empty. Poured now, it was hot to the last sip.

Soup poured while it steams is hot to the bottom of the mug, and soup poured later is not.

For whoever pours it while it is still hot, not later.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A kitchen with a long counter. At the right a soup pot with steam and, at the middle, an empty cream mug. A ink-black block figure with narrowed white eyes trembles at the left, then its eyes go wide, it steps closer and the mug hops in an arc to the pot, the lid lifts, and the mug lands steaming. Its eyes turn happy with a pulse. The text changes from: me: I'll pour it later, to: poured it hot. right now.
